line_items.reasoning: Q4 NII was guided to $12.4B–$12.5B; full-year 2025 NII came in at $47.5B vs. the ~$47.7B full-year target, and Q4 NII implied by the full-year figure appears to have fallen short of the $12.4B–$12.5B guided range.
Full-year 2025 noninterest expense came in at $54.8B vs. the raised guidance of ~$54.6B, and Q4 expense likely exceeded the ~$13.5B guide, suggesting a modest overshoot on costs.
Full-year 2025 ROTCE reached 15%, which is at the low end of (and technically below) the newly raised medium-term target of 17%–18%, though this is a multi-year goal rather than a Q4-specific target.
Q4 buybacks came in at $5.0B, below the guidance of roughly in line with Q3's $6.1B, representing an ~18% shortfall vs. the guided level.
